visual_blocks.heading: ORIGINAL MCQ MASTERY SET - EXACTLY 48 QUESTIONS
visual_blocks.preview: Questions 1-40 are core coverage - four per subtopic across the ten subtopics; Questions 41-48 are remedial items targeting the most common misreadings. Correct answers rotate strictly A -> B -> C -> D 12 times.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 1 - What an Ideology Is: The Discriminating Question of Domination
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Concept spine -> which SENSE of ideology is in play -> which DIAGNOSIS of domination (authority / property / mode of production) -> only then expound the specific doctrine.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 2 - Anarchism I: The Case Against the State
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: 10-mark anarchism = burden-of-justification argument in four moves + one named anchor (Bakunin corruption / Proudhon property / Kropotkin mutual aid) + a graded verdict; do not narrate a movement's history.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 3 - Anarchism II: Strands, Voluntary Order, Objections, and Gandhi
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Gandhi = anarchist in ideal, reformer in method. Objection ladder = security / scale / anthropology / HIDDEN AUTHORITY (the residual).

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 4 - Marxism I: Method, Dialectical and Historical Materialism
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Historical materialism = the six-step chain in premises + the reciprocal base/superstructure caution. Relevance stems = three columns: what it still explains / what it failed to predict / what its institutional record forecloses.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 5 - Marxism II: Alienation, Exploitation and Surplus Value
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Alienation 10-marker = definition + four dimensions + "broader than low wages" + species-being objection + verdict. Keep exposition dominant when the verb is "expound/present".

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 6 - Marxism III: Ideology, State, Revolution, Communism, Equality
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Freedom-consistency = the "only if... otherwise self-defeats" conditional. Marxism-as-ideology = the four §2.9 objections, each graded, + diagnosis/remedy split.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 7 - Marx After Marx: Lenin, Gramsci, Althusser, Miliband and Poulantzas
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: On any "is Marxism still relevant" stem, deploy the four-revision table + the relocation verdict; on any "state and class" stem, run Miliband -> Poulantzas -> relative-autonomy-must-stay-relative.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 8 - Socialism: The Family, Its Varieties, and Gandhian Socialism
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Compare-socialism-communism = shared axes in parallel (property/state/ distribution/method). Gandhian socialism = trusteeship cluster + voluntary- conversion objection + means-ends verdict.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 9 - Inter-School Debates: Anarchism, Marxism, Democratic Socialism, Gandhi, M. N. Roy
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Bring M. N. Roy to the freedom stem; run Bakunin-Marx on the state-abolition stem; always adjudicate the debate, never declare a knockout.

visual_blocks.heading: EXAM APPLICATION 10 - Criticisms, Replies and the Common Traps
visual_blocks.preview: MEMORY: Critically-examine = two objections, each with reply + residual, + graded verdict. Relevance = analytical survival vs institutional record. Never "prove" an ideology with a scheme or statute.
